entities.name: PMID:25071850
observations: Randomized clinical trial in 60 frozen-thawed embryo-transfer patients with refractory endometrium; 30 received vaginal Vagifem and 30 vaginal Premarin.
Endometrial thickness was assessed on day 14 of treatment; authors reported a statistically significant between-group difference favoring Vagifem (p<0.001).
The abstract reports means as 5.93±0.38 versus 6.74±0.32 mm while simultaneously identifying Vagifem as the thicker group, indicating a likely ordering or typographical error.
The study evaluated endometrial thickness, not powered clinical outcomes such as live birth; findings are limited by small sample size and single trial.

entities.name: Vagifem
observations: Vaginal estradiol tablet evaluated for endometrial preparation in refractory endometrium during frozen-thawed embryo-transfer cycles.
In PMID:25071850, authors concluded Vagifem produced greater endometrial thickening than vaginal Premarin.

entities.name: Vaginal Premarin
observations: Vaginal conjugated equine estrogen cream used as the comparator in a randomized trial of refractory endometrium during frozen-thawed embryo-transfer cycles.
In PMID:25071850, vaginal Premarin was associated with less endometrial thickening than Vagifem according to the authors’ reported comparison.
